summary.en: Keep bedside essentials within a compact, coordinated storage piece.
summary.zh: 用紧凑的双抽收纳整理床边常用物品。

description.en:
A dark bedside-cabinet design with two drawer fronts and a simple top surface for everyday items. The restrained shape works as a starting point for matching a bedroom furniture scheme.
Confirm the cabinet dimensions, board finish, drawer hardware and packing arrangement when requesting a quotation.
description.zh:
深色床头柜采用双抽屉外观与简洁台面，适合从统一卧室风格出发安排床边收纳。
询价时请核对柜体尺寸、板材饰面、抽屉五金及包装形式。

en: Dark finish with a simple rectangular profile.
Size, handles and drawer hardware confirmed by model.
zh: 深色外观与简洁方形轮廓。
尺寸、拉手及抽屉五金按款式确认。

value.en: Request model-specific order and sample terms
value.zh: 按款式询价确认起订量及样品条件

value.en: Confirm packing, assembly requirements and current lead time
value.zh: 核对包装、组装要求及当前交期
